limitations: Prices, brands and categories are source-provided labels, not authenticity, quality or availability verification.

Findsindex public listing API omits original marketplace URLs. Its product-detail API returned 401; no credentials were used. Public product pages remain linked and marketplace details load from those pages on demand.
Deduplication uses explicit product IDs and identical destination URLs. Similar names/images are not evidence of identical products.
Destination links are preserved from sources. Bulk destination probing is avoided after prior rate limits; working stock and individual destination availability are unverified.
Totals reflect accessible listing snapshots and may change during collection; inaccessible pages and products are not claimed as collected.
